user.title: Zaya Planner
user.description: Add the planner of smart home tasks. Tasks are created with the zaya_planner.upsert action and shown on the “Schedule” calendar.

data_description.lateness_hours: A task without its own `expires` is not run if it is later than this (for example after Home Assistant was off).
data_description.action_prefix: Only scripts whose entity id starts with this prefix can be tasks, for example script.plan_
data_description.retention_days: Finished tasks older than this are removed.
data_description.notify_action: Action that sends notifications about failed tasks, for example notify.mobile_app_phone or a script with title and message fields. Empty: a notification in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_prefix: The prefix must start with “script.” and name a group of scripts, for example script.plan_
error.invalid_action: Write an action as domain.action, for example notify.mobile_app_phone

upsert.name: Plan a task
upsert.description: Creates a task or changes it while its due time has not come. A task that is already due is left to the executor. A task of a rule (with rule_id) in the past is not created: rules plan only the future.

id.name: ID
id.description: Key of the current task. Among unfinished tasks it is unique: a second upsert with the same id changes the task.

title.name: Title
title.description: For people only: shown on the calendar and in the plan.

due.name: Due
due.description: When to run the task. Time without a time zone is local time.

action.name: Action
action.description: Script to run, for example script.plan_switch. Only scripts with the allowed prefix are accepted.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Passed to the script as its data.

expires.name: Expires
expires.description: Do not run after this time. “always” — run however late (use for turning things off). Empty — the lateness limit from the settings.

remove.name: Cancel tasks
remove.description: Cancels the unfinished task with this id, or the rule's tasks that are not due yet.

id.name: ID
id.description: Cancel the unfinished task with this id.

rule_id.name: Rule
rule_id.description: Cancel the rule's tasks whose due time has not come.

run_rule.name: Run rule
run_rule.description: Runs a rule now; its schedule stays as it is.

not_loaded.message: Zaya Planner is not set up.

action_not_allowed.message: Action {action} is not allowed: only scripts starting with {prefix} can be tasks.

expires_before_due.message: “expires” is earlier than “due”: the task could never run.

user.title: New rule
user.description: At the chosen time the rule calls its planner script with the parameters and rule_id. The planner works out the tasks and creates them with zaya_planner.upsert (passing the same rule_id).

data_description.rule_id: Latin letters, digits and _; cannot be changed later. Tasks of the rule carry it in rule_id.
data_description.planner: A script with the allowed prefix (see the integration settings) that answers ok and reason.
data_description.params: Passed to the planner together with rule_id.
data_description.time: Local time. For “Every hour” only the minutes count.
data_description.enabled: A disabled rule does not run; tasks it already planned stay.

reconfigure.title: Rule {rule_id}
reconfigure.description: Changing the repeat or the time plans the next run anew.

data_description.planner: A script with the allowed prefix (see the integration settings) that answers ok and reason.
data_description.params: Passed to the planner together with rule_id.
data_description.time: Local time. For “Every hour” only the minutes count.
data_description.enabled: A disabled rule does not run; tasks it already planned stay.

error.invalid_rule_id: Use only Latin letters, digits and _
error.rule_id_exists: A rule with this ID already exists
error.planner_not_allowed: The planner must be a script with the allowed prefix (see the integration settings)
error.invalid_params: Parameters must be a mapping (key: value)
